name: dsh-addons-manager
description: Bulk add-on manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Adds a settings section directly above extension hub's add-on manager with a multi-select add-on list, bulk enable/disable, bundle export/import (settings and optional source files), a per add-on config editor (form + JSON) and its own durable preferences.

scripts.test: node test/yamlkit.test.mjs && node test/patchops.test.mjs && node test/client.test.mjs
scripts.check: node --check lib/host.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/yamlkit.mjs && node --check lib/patchops.mjs
